blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has recorded a sharp increase in micro taxpayers benefiting from its One-Time Abatement Program, reaching 5,210 beneficiaries and P353.75 million in taxes and penalties abated as of Nov. 7. Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza said the recent increase is encouraging as the Dec. 31 deadline approaches. “We want to sustain this momentum and reach more qualified micro taxpayers who still have pending tax cases that can be resolved under the program,” Mendoza said.
